verdict.rationale: Docusaurus's built-in MDX support lets writers embed and import React/JSX components directly in Markdown without hand-writing HTML (docusaurus-docs-3, docusaurus-docs-17, docusaurus-docs-31), and community users confirm this React+Markdown blend as a core strength (docusaurus-comm-13, docusaurus-comm-20). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents Docusaurus's specific built-in components like Tabs, Admonitions/callouts, or code-group tabs by name, and one community comment complains the MDX/React/TS toolchain is 'over-engineered' for simple doc writing (docusaurus-comm-5). Missing for 10: explicit documentation citations for built-in Tabs, Admonition/callout syntax, and code-group components, plus independent hands-on confirmation that non-developers author these without touching HTML/JSX.
